text:
maria_sales: Prospect (CareAxis payer) asking for a 2-week POC: SAML SSO (Okta), SCIM provisioning for ~75k users, delegated admin across 3 subdomains, RBAC mapping to 8 roles, and option for a VPC connector. Need pricing and security Q responses. Can SE confirm blockers?
jia_se: Feasible. Need SAML metadata + SCIM service account. For 75k objects recommend bulk import then delta polling every 5-15m. Delegated admin requires domain ownership proof per subdomain (DNS TXT preferred).
oliver_sec: Compliance notes: HIPAA in-scope. Must have BAA signed before any PHI. We support customer-managed KMS for Private; draft line: "BYOK supported; keys remain in customer KMS and are not exported." Also can forward audit logs to customer Splunk/S3.
ben_soleng: POC checklist: 1) IdP metadata file, 2) SCIM creds + scope, 3) RBAC mapping CSV (group_external_id,group_name,role), 4) allowlist IPs and proxy settings, 5) KMS plan + legal BAA. Example RBAC CSV row: billing-admins,Billing Admins,billing_admin
maria_sales: They asked about SAML cert rotation without downtime.
jia_se: We support overlapping cert windows; upload new cert and set activation time so old cert remains valid during overlap.
ops-bot: ticket RED-36577 created (owner: jia_se) - https://redwood.atlassian.example/RED-36577
maria_sales: Thanks team. I'll request metadata and the CSV, and confirm the 2-week window. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
